scripts.build:zip: vite build && python3 -c "import zipfile, os; files = ['app.js', 'server.js', 'package.json', '.htaccess', '.env.example', 'NAMECHEAP_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md']; [zipfile.ZipFile('namecheap-deployment.zip', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED).write(f, arcname=f) for f in files if os.path.exists(f)]; zipf = zipfile.ZipFile('namecheap-deployment.zip', 'a', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [zipf.write(os.path.join(r, fl), arcname=os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, fl), '.')) for r, _, fls in os.walk('dist') for fl in fls]; zipf.close(); print('Ready: namecheap-deployment.zip')"
